Ryan Barwick / The Information :

 Filing: Google spent roughly $548M to buy around 3M shares of Qualcomm, which is pushing into serving the AI data center market   —  Google has bought nearly 3 million shares of the chip maker Qualcomm, less than half a percent of the company's outstanding shares, according to a securities filing on Friday.
